title: Opening Rail Lines to New Operators
what_it_is: Opening Rail Lines to New Operators

sections.label: Shorter rail licence periods
sections.summary: The New Rail Financing Framework in 2016 shortened rail operator licence periods from over 30 years to 15 years to spur contestability.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr S Iswaran)
sentences.text: Contestability will help spur operators to improve standards and put in more competitive tender bids.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr S Iswaran)
sentences.text: Therefore, when we introduced the New Rail Financing Framework in 2016, one of the changes was to shorten the licence period for rail operators from over 30 years to 15 years today.

sections.label: Competition in rail system
sections.summary: The balance between scale and competitiveness in the rail system is right as of now, and LTA remains open to foreign players through partnerships.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: First, we want to really promote competition because of the beneficial impact that it can have – what I have already explained.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: There is no reason to think, as of now, the equation has somehow shifted in the direction of going towards consolidation.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: So, policy design, as I have emphasised in some previous responses, must be informed by data and the experience and also the evolving circumstances.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: But, as of now, we think the balance is right in terms of between the need for scale and the benefits that go with it, as opposed to also the desire for greater competitiveness and contestability in our rail system.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: As I have said, first of all, we have not ruled out, but neither do we have any particular set of considerations that impel us in this direction of bringing in a completely new operator.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: However, for foreign players to come in, there are other mechanisms.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: So, for example, through partnerships with local players, so that they can share their expertise and also for some co-mingling of ideas and so on.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: And that is something that LTA remains open to.
